prompt: Camera holds still. The man drags his hand slowly down from his forehead over his eyes and lets it drop, staring at the glass. Beside him the woman breathes out a long, slow breath through parted lips, shoulders sinking, then opens her eyes and looks down at the controls. Small, tired, real movements; neither looks at the camera. Their faces and positions stay as in the frame, the coffee cup still in his hand. Arcade lights glow softly behind them. Sound: low arcade room tone, distant game jingles and a faint coin drop somewhere.
